newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Deutsche Bk gets Manila derivatives license.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche Bk gets Manila derivatives license.

text.p: The Philippine Monetary Board has approved the application of Deutsche Bank AG to offer financial derivatives to local clients, Central Bank governor Gabriel Singson said on Thursday.
Deustche Bank is the eighth bank in Manila to be allowed by the Central Bank to engage in derivatives.
Singson also said the Monetary Board cleared the applications of Boram Bank of Korea and United World Chinese Commercial Bank (UWCC) of Taiwan to open representative offices in the country.
Boram Bank, which is a leading arranger of corporate financing in the Southeast Asian region, had total assets of $18.1 billion at the end of 1996, the Central Bank said.
UWCC had total assets of $15 billion at the end of 1996, it said.
